<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">97</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">PART II</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Item 9, 9A</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_9_CHANGES_IN_DISAGREEMENTS_WITH_ACC"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ITEM&#160;9.</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_9_CHANGES_IN_DISAGREEMENTS_WITH_ACC"></a> CHANGES IN AND DISAGREEMENTS WITH ACCOU</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NTANTS ON ACCOUNTING AND FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE </font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Not applicable. </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:13pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_9A_CONTROLS_PROCEDURES"></a><a name="ITEM_9A_CONTROLS_PROCEDURES"></a>ITEM&#160;9A. CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Under the supervision and with the participation of our management, including the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, we have evaluated the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures as required by Exchange Act Rule 13a-15(b) as of the end of the period covered by this report. Based on that evaluation, the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer have concluded that these disclosure controls and procedures are effective. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:13pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="REPORT_MANAGEMENT_ON_INTERNAL_CONTROL_OV"></a><a name="REPORT_MANAGEMENT_ON_INTERNAL_CONTROL_OV"></a>REPORT OF MANAGEMENT ON INTERNAL CONTROL OVER FINANCIAL REPORTING </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting for the company. Internal control over financial reporting is a process to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of our financial reporting for external purposes in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America. Internal control over financial reporting includes maintaining records that in reasonable detail accurately and fairly reflect our transactions; providing reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary for preparation of our financial statements; providing reasonable assurance that receipts and expenditures of company assets are made in accordance with management authorization; and providing reasonable assurance that unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of company assets that could have a material effect on our financial statements would be prevented or detected on a timely basis. Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting is not intended to provide absolute assurance that a misstatement of our financial statements would be prevented or detected. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Management conducted an evaluation of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting based on the framework in <font style="font-style:italic;">Internal Control &#8211; Integrated Framework (2013)</font>&#160;issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission. Based on this evaluation, management concluded that the company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting was effective as of June 30, 2018. Deloitte&#160;&amp; Touche LLP has audited our internal control over financial reporting as of June 30, 2018; their report is included in Item&#160;9A. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">There were no changes in our internal control over financial reporting during the quarter ended June 30, 2018 that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting. We implemented internal controls to ensure we adequately evaluated our contracts and properly assessed the impact of the new accounting standards related to revenue recognition and leases on our financial statements to facilitate their adoption on July 1, 2017. There were no significant changes to our internal control over financial reporting due to the adoption of the new standards.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">98</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">PART II</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Item 9A</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="REPORT_INDEPENDENT_REGISTERED_PUBLIC_ACC"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="REPORT_INDEPENDENT_REGISTERED_PUBLIC_ACC"></a>REPORT OF INDEPENDENT REGIST</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ERED PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRM </font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">To the Stockholders and the Board of Directors of Microsoft Corporation</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Opinion on Internal Control over Financial Reporting</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We have audited the internal control over financial reporting of Microsoft Corporation and subsidiaries (the "Company") as of June 30, 2018, based on criteria established in <font style="font-style:italic;">Internal Control &#8212; Integrated Framework (2013) </font>issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO). In our opinion, the Company maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of June 30, 2018, based on the criteria established in <font style="font-style:italic;">Internal Control &#8212; Integrated Framework (2013)</font> issued by COSO.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We have also audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (PCAOB), the consolidated financial statements and the related notes (collectively referred to as the &#8220;financial statements&#8221;) as of and for the year ended June 30, 2018, of the Company and our report dated August 3, 2018, expressed an unqualified opinion on those financial statements and included an explanatory paragraph related to the Company&#8217;s change in method of accounting for revenue from contracts with customers and for accounting for leases in fiscal year 2018 due to the adoption of the new revenue standard and new lease standard, respectively.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Basis for Opinion</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company's management is responsible for maintaining effective internal control over financial reporting and for its assessment of the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting, included in the accompanying Report of Management on Internal Control over Financial Reporting. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company's internal control over financial reporting based on our audit. We are a public accounting firm registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We conducted our audit in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether effective internal control over financial reporting was maintained in all material respects. Our audit included obtaining an understanding of internal control over financial reporting, assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control based on the assessed risk, and performing such other procedures as we considered necessary in the circumstances. We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Definition and Limitations of Internal Control over Financial Reporting</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">A company's internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. A company's internal control over financial reporting includes those policies and procedures that (1) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (2) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance with authorizations of management and directors of the company; and (3) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the company's assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not prevent or detect misstatements. Also, projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk that controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions, or that the degree of compliance with the policies or procedures may deteriorate.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">/s/&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;D<font style="font-size:7.5pt;">ELOITTE</font>&#160;&amp; T<font style="font-size:7.5pt;">OUCHE</font> LLP </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Seattle, Washington </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">August 3, 2018 </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">99</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">PART II, III</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Item 9B, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_9B_OR_INFORMATION"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_9B_OR_INFORMATION"></a>ITEM&#160;9B. OTHER</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> INFORMATION </font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">During the quarter ended December 31, 2017, Microsoft provided software services to a person or entity identified under section 560.304 of title 31, Code of Federal Regulations. The services constituted a cloud-based spam and malware filtering service and the cloud-based provision of Office 365 software services provided to two entities associated with the Iranian bank, Bank Sepah &#8211; Bank Sepah International PLC and Banque Sepah, respectively. For the former, an annual service fee equivalent to $600 was charged for a one-year period beginning in February 2017, and for the latter, use rights were charged at a price equivalent to approximately $55 per month from September 2016 through November 2017, totaling $770. It is not possible to determine the precise profits, if any, attributable to these activities, though they are less than the associated revenues. Microsoft has ceased providing these software services to these entities and has no intention of doing so in the future.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:13pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">PART III </p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Exhibit 10.5</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">MICROSOFT CORPORATION</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M1"></a>DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M2"></a><a name="_DV_C5"></a><a name="_DV_M3"></a><a name="_DV_C5"></a>(Restated Effective as of <a name="_DV_M3"></a>May 15, 2015)</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M4"></a>1.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Purpose</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M5"></a>The purpose of the Microsoft Corporation Deferred Compensation Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;) is to further the long-term growth of Microsoft Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) by allowing selected Company executives and other senior management or highly compensated employees to defer receipt of certain compensation in order to keep their financial interests aligned with the Company and provide them with a long-term incentive to continue employment with the Company.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M6"></a>The Plan was formerly known as the 1998 Microsoft Corporation Stock Option Gain and Bonus Deferral Program.&nbsp;&nbsp;The name of the Plan was changed pursuant to a restatement effective January 1, 2006.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M7"></a>This Plan is intended (1) to comply with section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code, as amended (the &#8220;Code&#8221;) and official guidance issued thereunder (except with respect to amounts covered by Appendix B), and (2) to be &#8220;a plan which is unfunded and is maintained by an employer primarily for the purpose of providing deferred compensation for a select group of management or highly compensated employees&#8221; within the meaning of sections 201(2), 301(a)(3) and 401(a)(1) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974.&nbsp;&nbsp;Notwithstanding any other provision of this Plan, this Plan shall be interpreted, operated and administered in a manner consistent with these intentions.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M8"></a>2.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Effective Date</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M9"></a><a name="_DV_C7"></a><a name="_DV_C7"></a>The Plan was originally effective November 18, 1998.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as specifically set forth below, this restatement of the Plan is effective as of May 15, 2015.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M10"></a>3.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Definitions</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M11"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Account</font> &#8211; means a bookkeeping account established by the Company for each Participant electing to defer Eligible Income under the Plan, which may include sub-accounts for different types of Eligible Income deferred and for amounts payable at different times and/or payable in different forms.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M12"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M13"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition Retention Bonus</font> &#8211; means a bonus provided to a Newly Hired Eligible Employee who continues employment with the Company or a Designated Subsidiary after the acquisition of a business by the Company or a Designated Subsidiary or who begins employment with the Company or a Designated Subsidiary as part of a strategic alliance.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M14"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition Signing Bonus</font> &#8211; means a bonus provided to a Newly Hired Eligible Employee upon acceptance of an offer to continue employment with the Company or a Designated Subsidiary after the acquisition of a business by the Company or a Designated Subsidiary or to begin employment with the Company or Designated Subsidiary as part of a strategic alliance.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M15"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Affiliate</font> &#8211; means any corporation or other entity that is treated as a single employer with the Company under Code section 414.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M16"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Annual Base Salary</font> &#8211; means the regular annual base salary paid to an Eligible Employee.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M17"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Annual Bonus</font> &#8211; means the amount payable to an Eligible Employee as an annual bonus that is awarded in connection with the Company&#8217;s annual process under the Annual Bonus Plan or the cash portion of awards under the Executive Incentive Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Board</font> &#8211; means the Board of Directors of Microsoft Corporation.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M18"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Code</font> &#8211; means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M19"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Company</font> &#8211; means Microsoft Corporation.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M20"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU2"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Date of Hire</font><font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> &#8211; means the date of a Participant&#8217;s first day of active employment with the Company and its Affiliates.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M21"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Designated Subsidiary</font> &#8211; means a subsidiary of the Company that has been approved for participation in the Plan by the Senior HR Officer.&nbsp;&nbsp;A listing of the Designated Subsidiaries is in Appendix A.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M22"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Disabled</font> &#8211; means:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M23"></a><a name="BM409Awayw2ywCywiy"></a><a name="TCODEq40518z25"></a><a name="_DV_M24"></a><a name="BM409Awayw2ywCywiiy"></a><a name="TCODEq40518z26"></a><a name="_DV_M25"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"><a name="BM409Awayw2ywCywiy"></a><a name="TCODEq40518z25"></a><a name="_DV_M24"></a>A Participant</font><a name="BM409Awayw2ywCywiiy"></a><a name="TCODEq40518z26"></a><a name="_DV_M25"></a> (1) is unable to engage in any substantial gainful activity by reason of any medically determinable physical or mental impairment which can be expected to result in death or can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months, or (2) is, by reason of any medically determinable physical or mental impairment which can be expected to result in death or can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months, receiving income replacement benefits for a period of not less than 3 months under an accident and health plan covering employees of the participant&#8217;s employer.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M26"></a><a name="_DV_M27"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">The </font>Plan Administrator, in its complete and sole discretion, shall determine whether a Participant is Disabled.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator may<a name="_DV_M27"></a> require that the Participant submit to an examination on an annual basis, at the expense of the Company, by a competent physician or medical clinic selected by the Plan Administrator to assist in determining whether the Participant is Disabled.&nbsp;&nbsp;On the basis of such medical evidence, the determination of the Plan Administrator as to whether or not the Participant is Disabled (or whether he continues to be Disabled) shall be conclusive.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Eligible Employee</font> &#8211; means: </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M28"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Employee of the Company or a Designated Subsidiary working in the U.S. at the Company&#8217;s stock level 68 or above and, effective with respect to Eligible Income earned for periods beginning on or after January 1, 2012, an Employee of the Company or a Designated Subsidiary working in the U.S. at the Company&#8217;s stock level 67 or above.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M29"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Employee meeting the criteria of subsection (a) will not fail to be considered an Eligible Employee solely as a result of being on </font><font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">paid</font> or unpaid leave.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M30"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Eligible Income</font> &#8211; means compensation which may be deferred under the Plan, as from time to time determined by the Plan Administrator, including without limitation (1) Regular Enrollment Compensation and (2) New Hire Enrollment Compensation.&nbsp;&nbsp;Amounts will qualify as &#8220;Eligible Income&#8221; only if the Participant is on the U.S. payroll of the Company or its Affiliates at the time the amount is payable to the Participant absent deferral.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M31"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Employee</font> &#8211; means an individual who is a regular employee on the U.S. payroll of the Company or its Affiliates.&nbsp;&nbsp;The term &#8220;Employee&#8221; shall not include a person hired as an independent contractor, leased employee, consultant, or a person otherwise designated by the Company or an Affiliate as not eligible to participate in the Plan, even if such person is determined to be a common law employee of the Company or an Affiliate by any governmental or judicial authority.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M32"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">ERISA</font> &#8211; means the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M33"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Fiscal Year Compensation</font> &#8211; means &#8220;fiscal year compensation&#8221; as defined under Treas. Reg. &#167; 1.409A-2(a)(6) or any successor thereto.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M34"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Hire Date</font> &#8211; means the date an Employee becomes employed by the Company or a Designated Subsidiary.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the case of an individual who becomes an Employee upon the acquisition of a business by the Company or a Designated Subsidiary, the Employee&#8217;s &#8220;Hire Date&#8221; shall be his transfer date.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M35"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Investment Options</font> &#8211; means a set of investment options, which may include investment options offered under the 401(k) Plan, and which are from time to time determined by the Plan Administrator and used to credit earnings, gains, and losses on Account balances.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M36"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Key Employee</font> &#8211; means an employee treated as a &#8220;specified employee&#8221; under Code section 409A(a)(2)(B)(i) as of his Separation from Service (i.e., a key employee (as defined under Code section 416(i) without regard to paragraph (5) thereof) of a corporation any stock of which is publicly traded on an established securities market or otherwise).&nbsp;&nbsp;Key Employees shall be determined in accordance with Code section 409A, using a December 31 identification date.&nbsp;&nbsp;A listing of Key Employees as of an identification date shall be effective for the 12-month period beginning on the April 1 following the identification date.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M37"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">New Hire Enrollment Compensation</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> &#8211; means compensation for a Newly Hired Eligible Employee which is from time to time determined by the Plan Administrator, including without limitation a (1) New Hire Signing Bonus, (2) Acquisition Retention Bonus, and (3) Acquisition Signing Bonus.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M38"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">New Hire Signing Bonus</font> &#8211; means a bonus provided to a Newly Hired Eligible Employee upon acceptance of an offer of employment with the Company or a Designated Subsidiary.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M39"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Newly Hired Eligible Employee</font> &#8211; means an individual hired by the Company or a Designated Subsidiary who meets the criteria for an Eligible Employee on his Hire Date, provided that an individual who has previously worked for the Company or an Affiliate will only qualify as a &#8220;Newly Hired Eligible Employee&#8221; if he meets the requirements of Treas. Reg. &#167; 1.409A-2(a)(7) or any successor thereto.&nbsp;&nbsp;Generally, a re-hired individual will meet these requirements if (1) he has been paid any and all amounts due him under the Plan (and any plans required to be aggregated with the Plan under Code section 409A) prior to re-hire, or (2) he has not been eligible to participate, other than the accrual of earnings, in the Plan (or any other plan required to be aggregated with the Plan under Code section 409A) for at least 24 months.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M40"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Open Enrollment</font> &#8211; means the period or periods during each Plan Year when Eligible Employees may elect to defer amounts under the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Open Enrollment shall be held at the time or times designated by the Plan Administrator.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M41"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Participant</font> &#8211; means an Eligible Employee who elects to defer Eligible Income under the Plan. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M42"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Performance-Based Compensation</font> &#8211; means &#8220;performance-based compensation&#8221; as defined under Code section 409A.&nbsp;&nbsp; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M43"></a><a name="_DV_M44"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Plan</font> &#8211; means the Microsoft Corporation Deferred Compensation Plan, as amended from time to time.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M45"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M46"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Plan Administrator</font> &#8211; means the Senior HR Officer or, with respect to the eligibility of executive officers of the Company to participate in the Plan, the Compensation Committee of the Board.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M47"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Plan Year</font> &#8211; means the 12-month period from January 1 to December 31.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;color:#auto;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C8"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Pre-2014 Election Amount</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"> &#8211; means an amount deferred under the Plan (and earnings thereon) pursuant to a deferral election that (1) becomes irrevocable during an Open Enrollment period occurring before July 1, 2013, or (2) is made by a Newly Hired Eligible Employee under Section 5.1(b)(ii) and becomes irrevocable on or before December 31, 2013.&nbsp;&nbsp;Thus, Annual Base Salary amounts deferred after 2013 and Annual Bonuses deferred based on elections made after 2013 will not be considered Pre-2014 Election Amounts.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M48"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Regular Enrollment Compensation</font> &#8211; means compensation which is from time to time determined by the Plan Administrator, including without limitation (1) Annual Base Salary, and (2) Annual Bonus.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M49"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Retirement</font> &#8211; means a Separation from Service after attaining Retirement Age.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M50"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Retirement Age</font> &#8211; means one specified date for each Participant occurring on the earlier of:&nbsp;&nbsp;(1) Participant&#8217;s attainment of age sixty-five (65), or (2) the later of Participant&#8217;s attainment of age fifty-five (55) or the tenth (10th) anniversary of his Date of Hire.&nbsp;&nbsp;When an Employee becomes eligible to participate in the Plan, the Plan Administrator shall determine the Retirement Age for the Employee as one specified date in accordance with the foregoing.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M51"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Senior HR Officer</font> &#8211; means the senior <font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">officer</font> in charge of the Human Resources department.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M52"></a><a name="_DV_C9"></a><a name="_DV_M53"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;"><a name="_DV_C9"></a>Separation from Service </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M53"></a>or Separates from Service </font>&#8211; means a &#8220;separation from service&#8221; with the Company and its Affiliates within the meaning of Code section 409A.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M54"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">401(k) Plan</font> &#8211; means the Microsoft Corporation Savings Plus 401(k) Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M55"></a>4.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Participation</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M56"></a>4.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Eligible Employee becomes an active Participant in the Plan on the date he first enrolls in the Plan by electing to defer all or any portion of his Eligible Income.&nbsp;&nbsp;An Eligible Employee may enroll in the Plan during Open Enrollment in accordance with Section 5.1(b)(i) or pursuant to Section 5.1(c).&nbsp;&nbsp;A Newly Hired Eligible Employee may enroll before his Hire Date in accordance with 5.1(b)(ii).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M57"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU4"></a><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4.2</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Eligible Employee who has been an active Participant under the Plan will cease to be a Participant on the date his Account is fully distributed.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M58"></a>5.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Participant Accounts</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M59"></a>5.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Elections to Defer Eligible Income</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M60"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Initial Deferral Election</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;An Eligible Employee may make an irrevocable election to defer the following types of Eligible Income in one (1) percent increments up to the specified maximum percentages:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;"><a name="_DV_M61"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M62"></a><a name="_DV_C11"></a><a name="_DV_M63"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"><a name="_DV_C11"></a>An Eligible Employee may elect to defer up to </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M63"></a>75</font>% of his Annual Base Salary.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.64%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M64"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Eligible Employee may elect to defer up to 100% of a </font>Annual Bonus.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.45%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M65"></a>(iii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Eligible Employee may elect to defer up to 90% of New Hire Enrollment Compensation. </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M66"></a>Eligible Employees are not permitted to defer gains on the exercise of a stock option under the Plan after December 31, 2004.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M67"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Time and Manner of Making an Initial Election</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M68"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">An Eligible Employee may make an election to defer one or more types of Regular Enrollment Compensation during an Open </font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">Enrollment</font> period that occurs in the Plan Year preceding the Plan Year in which the Regular Enrollment Compensation begins to be earned.&nbsp;&nbsp;A deferral election shall be made in accordance with procedures established by the Plan Administrator.&nbsp;&nbsp;An Employee&#8217;s election during such an Open Enrollment period will not be given effect if the Employee ceases to be an Eligible Employee by the last day of the month in which the Open Enrollment period occurs. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M69"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A Newly Hired </font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">Eligible</font> Employee may make an election to defer one or more types of New Hire Enrollment Compensation in accordance with procedures established by the Plan Administrator, provided such election occurs before his Hire Date and such election shall only apply to amounts earned after the election is filed.&nbsp;&nbsp;A Newly Hired Eligible Employee may make an election to defer Regular Enrollment Compensation during an Open Enrollment period that follows or coincides with his Hire Date.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M70"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Alternative Election Deadlines</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Notwithstanding the rules in subsection (b), if the Plan Administrator, in its sole discretion, determines that:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M71"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">Eligible Income constitutes Performance-Based Compensation that is based on services performed over a performance period of at least twelve (12) months, the Plan Administrator may establish procedures, including an Open Enrollment period, under which an Eligible Employee may elect to defer such Performance-Based Compensation, but such election must be made no later than six (6) months before the end of the performance period; or</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M72"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">Eligible Income constitutes Fiscal Year Compensation, the Plan Administrator may establish procedures, including an Open Enrollment period, under which an Eligible Employee may elect to defer such Fiscal Year Compensation, but such election must be made no later than the last day of the Company&#8217;s fiscal year immediately preceding the first fiscal year in which services are performed related to such Eligible Income.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M73"></a>An Employee&#8217;s election under this Section will not be given effect if the Employee ceases to be an Eligible Employee by the deadline stated above for making such an election.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M74"></a>(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Cancellation of Election</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;If a Participant becomes Disabled, receives a hardship withdrawal under the 401(k) Plan, or obtains a distribution under Section 6.6 on account of an unforeseeable emergency during a Plan Year, his deferral election for such Plan Year shall be cancelled.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M75"></a>5.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Crediting of Deferrals</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Eligible Income deferred by a Participant under the Plan shall be credited to the Participant&#8217;s Account as soon as practicable after the amounts would have otherwise been paid to the Participant.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M76"></a>5.3<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Vesting</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;A Participant shall at all times be one-hundred (100) percent vested in any amounts credited to his Account.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M77"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU5"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5.4</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Investments and Earnings</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall periodically credit gains, losses and earnings to a Participant&#8217;s Account, until the full balance of the Account has been distributed.&nbsp;&nbsp;Amounts shall be credited to a Participant&#8217;s Account under this Section based on the results that would have been achieved had amounts credited to the Account been invested as soon as practicable after crediting into the Investment Options selected by the Participant.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator shall specify procedures to allow Participants to make elections as to the deemed investment of amounts newly credited to their Accounts, as well as the deemed investment of amounts previously credited to their Accounts.&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing in this Section or otherwise in the Plan, however, will require the Company to actually invest any amounts in such Investment Options or otherwise.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M78"></a>5.5<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Employment Taxes</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">The Participant&#8217;s share of FICA and FUTA taxes owed on Eligible Income the Participant elects to defer shall be deducted from other compensation payable to the Participant.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M79"></a>6.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Distribution of Account Balances</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M80"></a>6.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Distribution Form</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M81"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A Participant may elect to have amounts deferred under the Plan (and earnings thereon) distributed in a lump sum payment or in annual installments over a period ranging from three (3) to fifteen (15) years.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M82"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M83"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A Participant must specify the form in which a deferred amount (and earnings thereon) will be distributed at the time of making the initial deferral election under Section 5.1.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M84"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">Notwithstanding the distribution form elected under subsection (a), if at the time a portion of a Participant&#8217;s Account is to be distributed, the portion of the balance to be distributed is less than $50,000, that portion shall be distributed in a lump sum payment at such time, provided that this subsection (c) shall not apply to any amounts deferred under the Plan pursuant to a deferral election that becomes irrevocable on or after June 30, 2011 (and earnings thereon).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M85"></a>(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">Distribution of a Participant&#8217;s Account balance shall be made in cash.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M86"></a><a name="_DV_C12"></a>6.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Distribution Time</font><a name="_DV_C12"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;">The rules in this Section 6.2 shall apply to amounts deferred under the Plan, excluding any portion of a Participant&#8217;s Account attributable to Pre-2014 Election Amounts.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M87"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A Participant may elect to have distribution of a deferred amount (and earnings thereon) commence as of the following dates:</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M88"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A specified time (a particular month and year); or </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M89"></a><a name="_DV_C14"></a><a name="_DV_M90"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"><a name="_DV_C14"></a>Upon the Participant&#8217;s </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M90"></a>Separation from Service (in which case distributions will commence in the month following Separation from Service)</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M91"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A Participant must specify their distribution commencement election at the time of making the initial deferral election under Section 5.1.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M92"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">If a Participant elects to have a deferred amount distributed as of a specified time, the specified time must be at least twelve (12) months after the date on which the final payment of the deferred amount would have been made to the Participant absent deferral.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;"><a name="_DV_M93"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M94"></a><a name="_DV_C15"></a><a name="_DV_M95"></a><a name="_DV_M96"></a><a name="_DV_C17"></a>6.3<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;"><a name="_DV_C15"></a>Distribution </font><font style="text-decoration:underline;color:#auto;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M95"></a>of Pre-2014 Election Amounts </font><font style="text-decoration:underline;"><a name="_DV_M96"></a>Upon Separation from Service</font><a name="_DV_C17"></a>. <font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"> The rules in this Section 6.3 shall only apply to Pre-2014 Election Amounts.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M97"></a><a name="_DV_C19"></a><a name="_DV_M98"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><a name="_DV_C19"></a>If a Participant reaches Retirement Age prior to having a Separation from Service, the distribution <font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M98"></a>of a Pre-2014 Election Amount</font> will commence as follows:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:13.89%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M99"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">If the Participant elected commencement upon Retirement, the distribution will commence in the month following Retirement.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M100"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">If the Participant elected commencement upon a specified time, the distribution will commence in the specified month and year. </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:13.89%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;"><a name="_DV_M101"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M105"></a><a name="_DV_C25"></a><a name="_DV_M106"></a><a name="_DV_C26"></a><a name="_DV_X38"></a><a name="_DV_C27"></a><a name="_DV_C28"></a><a name="_DV_X40"></a><a name="_DV_C29"></a><a name="_DV_M107"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"><a name="_DV_C21"></a>Notwithstanding a Participant&#8217;s elections </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M103"></a>with respect to Pre-2014 Election Amounts, (i) if</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C23"></a> a Participant</font><font style="color:#auto;letter-spacing:0pt;"><strike> </strike></font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a prior to reaching Retirement Age, </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M105"></a>the portion of </font><font the month following the Separation from Service</font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_X38"></a><a name="_DV_C27"></a>, and (ii) </font><font
