Disabled</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;color:#auto;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C31"></a><a name="_DV_M108"></a><a name="_DV_M109"></a><a name="_DV_C32"></a><a name="_DV_M111"></a><a name="_DV_C34"></a><a name="_DV_M112"></a><a name="_DV_C41"></a><a name="_DV_M113"></a><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.4</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Key Employee Delay</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"><a name="_DV_M108"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_M109"></a>Except as otherwise permitted under IRS guidance, if <a name="_DV_C32"></a> a distribution is to be made upon the Separation from Service of a Key Employee, distribution may not be made before the date which is six months after the date of the Key Employee&#8217;s Separation from Service (or, if earlier, the date of death of the Key Employee).&nbsp;&nbsp;Any payments that would otherwise be made during this period of delay shall be paid in accordance with the elected distribution method</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"><a name="_DV_M111"></a> and the terms of the Plan</font><font style="color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_C34"></a> in the seventh month following Separation from Service (or, if earlier, </font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"><a name="_DV_M112"></a>following</font><font style="color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_C41"></a> the Key Employee&#8217;s death</font><strike> </strike><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"><a name="_DV_M113"></a>in accordance with Sections 6.5(a) and (b) below)</font><font style="color:#000000;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M114"></a>6.5<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Distributions Upon Death</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M115"></a><a name="_DV_C44"></a><a name="_DV_M116"></a><a name="_DV_C45"></a><a name="_DV_M117"></a><a name="_DV_C46"></a><a name="_DV_M118"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><a name="_DV_C44"></a>Notwithstanding a Participant&#8217;s elections <font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M116"></a>with respect to Pre-2014 Election Amounts,</font><a name="_DV_C45"></a> if a Participant dies prior to attaining Retirement Age while employed with the Company or an Affiliate, <font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M117"></a>the portion of </font><a name="_DV_C46"></a>his Account balance<font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M118"></a> attributable to the Pre-2014 Election Amounts</font> shall be distributed to the Participant&#8217;s beneficiary in an immediate single lump sum payment in the month following the date of the Participant&#8217;s death.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:20.83%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;"><a name="_DV_C47"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_X37"></a><a name="_DV_C48"></a><a name="_DV_C49"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"><a name="_DV_C49"></a>Notwithstanding a Participant&#8217;s elections under Sections 6.1 and 6.2, </font><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;">if a Participant dies, his Account balance, excluding any portion attributable to Pre-2014 Election Amounts, shall be distributed to the Participant&#8217;s beneficiary in a single lump sum payment on the date six months after the date of the Participant&#8217;s death.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:6.94%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M119"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font>A Participant shall designate his beneficiary prior to death in accordance with procedures established by the Plan Administrator.&nbsp;&nbsp;If a Participant has not properly designated a beneficiary or if no designated beneficiary is living on the date of distribution, such amount shall be distributed to the Participant&#8217;s beneficiary designated under the 401(k) Plan, or if no designated beneficiary under the 401(k) Plan is living, in accordance with the default provisions under the 401(k) Plan. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M120"></a>(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font>For purposes of determining the proper death beneficiary under this Plan, this Plan shall not be interpreted as preempting applicable state law regarding the ownership rights of Accounts upon a Participant&#8217;s death.&nbsp;&nbsp;For example, although this Plan states that upon a Participant&#8217;s death, Account balances will be paid to his beneficiary, the personal representative will be obligated to pay any benefits owed to a spouse or otherwise as a result of any applicable community property laws. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M121"></a><a name="_DV_M122"></a><a name="_Toc86760670"></a><a name="_DV_M123"></a><a name="FinancialEmergency"></a><a name="_DV_M124"></a>6.6<font style="margin-left:36pt;"><a name="_DV_M122"></a><a name="_Toc86760670"></a></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Withdrawals for Unforeseeable Emergency</font><a name="_DV_M123"></a><a name="FinancialEmergency"></a><a name="_DV_M124"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;A Participant may withdraw all or any portion of his Account balance for an Unforeseeable Emergency.&nbsp;&nbsp;The amounts distributed with respect to an Unforeseeable Emergency may not exceed the amounts necessary to satisfy such Unforeseeable Emergency plus amounts necessary to pay taxes reasonably anticipated as a result of the distribution, after taking into account the extent to which such hardship is or may be relieved through reimbursement or compensation by insurance or otherwise or by liquidation of the Participant&#8217;s assets (to the extent the liquidation of such assets would not itself cause severe financial hardship) or by cessation of deferrals under the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;&#8220;Unforeseeable Emergency&#8221; means for this purpose a severe financial hardship to a Participant resulting from an illness or accident of the Participant, the Participant&#8217;s spouse, or a dependent of the Participant, loss of the Participant&#8217;s property due to casualty, or other similar extraordinary and unforeseeable circumstances arising as a result of events beyond the control of the Participant.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M125"></a>Except as otherwise permitted under IRS guidance, a Participant shall be required to take any available hardship withdrawals from the 401(k) Plan before being eligible to receive a withdrawal under this section.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M126"></a><a name="_DV_C53"></a><a name="_DV_M127"></a>6.7<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Changes in Time or Form of Distribution</font><a name="_DV_C53"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M127"></a>To the extent permitted in accordance with procedures established by the Plan Administrator, a Participant </font>may make one or more subsequent elections to change the time or form of a distribution to be made as of a specified time or upon the occurrence of a distributable event for a deferred amount, but such an election will be effective only if the following conditions are satisfied:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M128"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">The election may not take effect until at least twelve (12) months after the date on which the election is made;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M129"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">A distribution may not be made earlier than at least five (5) years from the date the distribution would have otherwise been made;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M130"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU7"></a><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(c)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;">In the case of an election to change the time or form of a distribution payable as of a specified time, the election must be made at least twelve (12) months before the date of the first scheduled distribution; and</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:13.89%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M131"></a>(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font>The election may not result in an impermissible acceleration of payment prohibited under Code section 409A.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M132"></a>6.8<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Effect of Taxation</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;If a portion of the Participant&#8217;s Account balance is includible in income under Code section 409A, such portion shall be distributed immediately to the Participant.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M133"></a>6.9<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Payment of Taxes</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;If state, local, or foreign tax obligations arise from participation in the Plan that apply to an amount deferred under the Plan before such amount is paid or made available to the Participant (the &#8220;Taxes&#8221;), the Company shall pay a portion of such deferred amount by distribution (a) to the Participant in the form of withholding pursuant to provisions of applicable state, local, or foreign law; or (b) directly to the Participant.&nbsp;&nbsp;In no event shall the total payment under this Section 6.9 exceed the aggregate amount of the Taxes, and the income tax withholding related to such Taxes.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M134"></a>6.10<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Settlement of Bona Fide Dispute</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Subject to certain presumptions under Code section 409A, if an arm&#8217;s length, bona fide dispute between a Participant and the Company arises as to the Participant&#8217;s right to an amount deferred under the Plan, the payment of the deferred amount as part of a settlement of such dispute shall be distributed immediately to the Participant.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M135"></a>6.11<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Offset for Obligations to Company</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Participant has any debt, obligation or other liability representing an amount owing to the Company (the &#8220;Debt&#8221;), incurred in the ordinary course of his employment relationship, the Company shall offset the Debt against the Participant&#8217;s Account balance.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall reduce the Participant&#8217;s Account balance in satisfaction of the Debt at the same time and in the same amount as the Debt otherwise would have been due and collected from the Participant; provided however, in no event shall the amount of such offset in any of the Company&#8217;s taxable years exceed $5,000.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M136"></a><a name="_DV_M137"></a>6.12<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">2005 Deferred Compensation</font><a name="_DV_M137"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as provided in Appendix C, Sections 6.1-6.11 shall govern the distribution of compensation earned and deferred under the Plan during the 2005 Plan Year. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M138"></a>6.13<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Pre-2005 Deferrals</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Notwithstanding the foregoing, Appendix B governs the distribution of amounts that were earned and vested (within the meaning of Code section 409A and regulations thereunder) under the Plan prior to 2005 (and earnings thereon) and are exempt from the requirements of Code section 409A.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M139"></a>7.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Administration</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M140"></a><a name="_DV_M141"></a>7.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">General Administration</font><a name="_DV_M141"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator shall be responsible for the operation and administration of the Plan and for carrying out the provisions hereof.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator shall have the full authority and discretion to make, amend, interpret, and enforce all appropriate rules and regulations for the administration of this Plan and decide or resolve any and all questions, including interpretations of this Plan, as may arise in connection with this Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as otherwise provided in Section 7.2, any such action taken by the Plan Administrator shall be final and conclusive on any party.<font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;To the extent the </font>Plan Administrator<font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;"> has been granted discretionary authority under the Plan, the </font>Plan Administrator<font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">&#8217;s prior exercise of such authority shall not obligate it to exercise its authority in a like fashion thereafter.</font>&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator shall be entitled to rely conclusively upon all tables, valuations, certificates, opinions and reports furnished by any actuary, accountant, controller, counsel or other person employed or engaged by the Company with respect to the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator may, from time to time, employ agents and delegate to such agents, including other employees of the Company, such administrative duties as it sees fit.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:6.94%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M142"></a>7.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Claims for Benefits</font>. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M143"></a>(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Filing a Claim</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;A Participant or his authorized representative may file a claim for benefits under the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any claim must be in writing and submitted to the Senior HR Officer at such address as may be specified from time to time.&nbsp;&nbsp;Claimants will be notified in writing of approved claims, which will be processed as claimed.&nbsp;&nbsp;A claim is considered approved only if its approval is communicated in writing to a claimant.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M144"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU8"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Denial of Claim</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the case of the denial of a claim respecting benefits paid or payable with respect to a Participant, a written notice will be furnished to the claimant within 90 days of the date on which the claim is received by the Senior HR Officer.&nbsp;&nbsp;If special circumstances (such as for a hearing) require a longer period, the claimant will be notified in writing, prior to the expiration of the 90-day period, of the reasons for an extension of time; provided, however, that no extensions will be permitted beyond 90 days after the expiration of the initial 90-day period.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M145"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Reasons for Denial</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;A denial or partial denial of a claim will be dated and signed by the Senior HR Officer and will clearly set forth:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M146"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">the specific reason or reasons for the denial;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M147"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">specific reference to pertinent Plan provisions on which the denial is based;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M148"></a>(iii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">a description of any additional material or information necessary for the claimant to perfect the claim and an explanation of why such material or information is necessary; and</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M149"></a>(iv)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">an explanation of the procedure for review of the denied or partially denied claim set forth below, including the claimant&#8217;s right to bring a civil action under ERISA section 502(a) following an adverse benefit determination on review.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M150"></a>(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Review of Denial</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Upon denial of a claim, in whole or in part, a claimant or his duly authorized representative will have the right to submit a written request to the Senior HR Officer for a full and fair review of the denied claim by filing a written notice of appeal with the Senior HR Officer within 60 days of the receipt by the claimant of written notice of the denial of the claim.&nbsp;&nbsp;A claimant or the claimant&#8217;s authorized representative will have, upon request and free of charge, reasonable access to, and copies of, all documents, records, and other information relevant to the claimant&#8217;s claim for benefits and may submit issues and comments in writing.&nbsp;&nbsp;The review will take into account all comments, documents, records, and other information submitted by the claimant relating to the claim, without regard to whether such information was submitted or considered in the initial benefit determination. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M151"></a>If the claimant fails to file a request for review within 60 days of the denial notification, the claim will be deemed abandoned and the claimant precluded from reasserting it.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the claimant does file a request for review, his request must include a description of the issues and evidence he deems relevant.&nbsp;&nbsp;Failure to raise issues or present evidence on review will preclude those issues or evidence from being presented in any subsequent proceeding or judicial review of the claim.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M152"></a>(e)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Decision Upon Review</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Senior HR Officer will provide a prompt written decision on review.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the claim is denied on review, the decision shall set forth:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M153"></a>(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">the specific reason or reasons for the adverse determination;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M154"></a>(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">specific reference to pertinent Plan provisions on which the adverse determination is based;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M155"></a>(iii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">a statement that the claimant is entitled to receive, upon request and free of charge, reasonable access to, and copies of, all documents, records, and other information relevant to the claimant&#8217;s claim for benefits; and </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:20.83%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M156"></a>(iv)<font style="margin-left:36pt;">a statement describing any voluntary appeal procedures offered by the Plan and the claimant&#8217;s right to obtain the information about such procedures, as well as a statement of the claimant&#8217;s right to bring an action under ERISA section 502(a).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M157"></a>A decision will be rendered no more than 60 days after the Senior HR Officer&#8217;s receipt of the request for review, except that such period may be extended for an additional 60 days if the Senior HR Officer determines that special circumstances (such as for a hearing) require such extension.&nbsp;&nbsp;If an extension of time is required, written notice of the extension will be furnished to the claimant before the end of the initial 60-day period.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:9pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M158"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU9"></a><a name="_Toc17183182"></a><a name="_DV_M159"></a><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(f)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Finality of Determinations; Exhaustion of Remedies</font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.</font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M159"></a></font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;To the extent permitted by law, decisions reached under the claims procedures set forth in this Section shall be final and binding on all parties. No legal action for benefits under the Plan shall be brought unless and until the claimant has exhausted his remedies under this Section. In any such legal action, the claimant may only present evidence and theories which the claimant presented during the claims procedure. Any claims which the claimant does not in good faith pursue through the review stage of the procedure shall be treated as having been irrevocably waived. Judicial review of a claimant&#8217;s denied claim shall be limited to a determination of whether the denial was an abuse of discretion based on the evidence and theories the claimant presented during the claims procedure. </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Any suit or legal action initiated by a claimant under the Plan must be brought by the claimant no later than one year following a final decision on the claim for benefits by the Senior HR Officer.&nbsp;&nbsp;The one-year limitation on suits for benefits will apply in any forum where a claimant initiates such suit or legal action.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M160"></a>(g)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Disability Claims</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Claims for disability benefits shall be determined under the DOL Regulation section 2560.503-1 which is hereby incorporated by reference.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.94%;"><a name="_DV_M161"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M162"></a>8.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Amendment and Termination</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M163"></a>8.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Amendment or Termination</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company reserves the right to amend or terminate the Plan when, in the sole discretion of the Company, such amendment or termination is advisable, pursuant to a resolution or other action taken by the Plan Administrator.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M164"></a>Notwithstanding the foregoing, no amendment of the Plan shall apply to amounts that were earned and vested (within the meaning of Code section 409A and regulations thereunder) under the Plan prior to 2005, unless the amendment specifically provides that it applies to such amounts.&nbsp;&nbsp;The purpose of this restriction is to prevent a Plan amendment from resulting in an inadvertent &#8220;material modification&#8221; to amounts that are &#8220;grandfathered&#8221; and exempt from the requirements of Code section 409A. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M165"></a>8.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Effect of Amendment or Termination</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;No amendment or termination of the Plan shall decrease the amounts credited to a Participant&#8217;s Account as of such amendment or termination.&nbsp;&nbsp;Upon termination of the Plan, Participants&#8217; Account balances shall be distributed in accordance with the terms of Section 6,<font style="font-weight:bold;"> </font>unless the Company determines in its sole discretion that all such amounts shall be distributed upon termination in accordance with the requirements under Code section 409A.<font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;"> </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M166"></a>9.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">General Provisions</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M167"></a>9.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Rights Unsecured</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;The right of a Participant or his beneficiary to receive a distribution hereunder shall be an unsecured claim against the general assets of the Company, and neither the Participant nor his beneficiary shall have any rights in or against any amount credited to any Account or any other assets of the Company.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan at all times shall be considered entirely unfunded for tax purposes.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any funds set aside by the Company for the purpose of meeting its obligations under the Plan, including any amounts held by a trustee, shall continue for all purposes to be part of the general assets of the Company and shall be available to its general creditors in the event of the Company&#8217;s bankruptcy or insolvency.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s obligation under this Plan shall be that of an unfunded and unsecured promise to pay money in the future. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M168"></a>9.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">No Right to Eligible Income</font><font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing in this Plan shall be construed to give any Eligible Employee any right to be granted Eligible Income or any other type of compensation.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M169"></a>9.3<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">No Enlargement of Rights</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;No Participant or beneficiary shall have any right to receive a distribution under the Plan except in accordance with the terms of the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Establishment of the Plan shall not be construed to give any Participant the right to continue to be employed by or provide services to the Company or its affiliates or to employment that is not terminable at will.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M170"></a>9.4<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">No Guarantee of Benefits</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing contained in the Plan shall constitute a guarantee by the Company or any other person or entity that the assets of the Company will be sufficient to pay any benefits hereunder.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M171"></a>9.5<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">Nonalienation of Benefits</font><font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;This Plan inures to the benefit of and is binding upon the parties hereto and their successors, heirs and assigns; provided, however, that the amounts credited to a Participant&#8217;s Account are not, except as provided in Sections 9.6 and 6.11, subject in any manner to anticipation, alienation, sale, transfer, assignment, pledge, encumbrance, charge, garnishment, execution or levy of any kind, either voluntary or involuntary, and any attempt to anticipate, alienate, sell, transfer, assign, pledge, encumber, charge or otherwise dispose of any right to any benefits payable hereunder, will be null and void and not binding on the Plan or the Company.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M172"></a>9.6<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Taxes</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition to its rights under section 5.5, t<font style="letter-spacing:-0.15pt;">he Company or other payor may withhold from a benefit payment under the Plan or a Participant&#8217;s wages any federal, state, or local taxes required by law to be withheld with respect to a payment or accrual under the Plan, and shall report such payments and other Plan-related information to the appropriate governmental agencies as required under applicable law.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M173"></a>9.7<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;letter-spacing:0.1pt;">Participant&#8217;s Cooperation</font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall cooperate with the Company by furnishing any and all information requested by the Plan Administrator in order to facilitate the payment of benefits hereunder, taking such physical examinations as the Plan Administrator may deem necessary and taking such other actions as may be requested by the </font>Plan Administrator. If the Participant refuses to cooperate, the Company shall have no further obligation to the Participant under the Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M174"></a>9.8<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Incapacity of Recipient</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;If any person entitled to a distribution under the Plan is deemed by the Plan Administrator to be incapable of personally receiving and giving a valid receipt for such payment, then, unless and until a claim for such payment shall have been made by a duly appointed guardian or other legal representative of such person, the Plan Administrator may provide for such payment or any part thereof to be made to any other person or institution then contributing toward or providing for the care and maintenance of such person.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any such payment shall be a payment for the account of such person and a complete discharge of any liability of the Company and the Plan with respect to the payment.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M175"></a>9.9<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Legally Binding</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event of any consolidation, merger, acquisition or reorganization, the obligations of the Company under this Plan shall continue and be binding on the Company and its successors or assigns.&nbsp;&nbsp;The rights, privileges, benefits and obligations under the Plan are intended to be legal obligations of the Company and binding upon the Company, its successors and assigns.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M176"></a>9.10<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Unclaimed Benefits</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Each Participant shall keep the Plan Administrator informed of his current address and the current address of his designated beneficiary.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator shall not be obligated to search for the whereabouts of any person if the location of a person is not made known to the Plan Administrator.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M177"></a>9.11<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Severability</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event any provision of the Plan shall be held invalid or illegal for any reason, any illegality or invalidity shall not affect the remaining parts of the Plan, but the Plan shall be construed and enforced as if the illegal or invalid provision had never been inserted.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M178"></a>9.12<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Words and Headings</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Words in the masculine gender shall include the feminine and the singular shall include the plural, and vice versa, unless qualified by the context.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any headings used herein are included for ease of reference only, and are not to be construed so as to alter the terms hereof.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M179"></a>9.13<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Applicable Law and Venue</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;To the extent not preempted by federal law, the Plan shall be governed by the laws of the State of Washington.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event the Company or any Participant (or beneficiary) initiates litigation related to this Plan, the venue for such action will be in King County, Washington.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M180"></a>9.14<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;letter-spacing:0.1pt;">Waiver of Breach</font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The waiver by the Company of any breach of any provision of the Plan by the Participant shall not operate or be construed as a waiver of any subsequent breach by the Participant.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;letter-spacing:0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M181"></a>9.15<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Notice</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any notice or filing required or permitted to be given to the Plan Administrator under the Plan shall be sufficient if in writing and hand-delivered, or sent by first class mail to the principal office of the Company, directed to the attention of the Plan Administrator.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such notice shall be deemed given as of the date of delivery, or, if delivery is made by mail, as of the date shown on the postmark.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M182"></a>9.16<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Attorneys&#8217; Fees and Costs</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event that a dispute regarding benefits arises between the Company or Plan Administrator and a Participant (or beneficiary) and such dispute is resolved through arbitration or litigation in court, the prevailing party(ies) shall be entitled to their reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees and costs incurred in such action.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:6.94%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:6.94%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;color:#auto;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C54"></a><a name="_DV_M183"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU10"></a><a name="_DV_C56"></a><font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><br /><a name="_DV_M183"></a></font></p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M187"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">DESIGNATED SUBSIDIARIES</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M188"></a>(As of May 15, 2015)</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M189"></a><a name="_DV_M190"></a>1654:&nbsp;&nbsp;MOL Corporation</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M191"></a>1693:&nbsp;&nbsp;Vexcel Corporation</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M192"></a>1548:&nbsp;&nbsp;Microsoft Online, Inc.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M193"></a>1888:&nbsp;&nbsp;Microsoft Payments, Inc.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M194"></a>1899:&nbsp;&nbsp;Microsoft Open Technologies, Inc.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1988:&nbsp;&nbsp;Microsoft Technology Licensing</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M195"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU12"></a><br /></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;">APPENDIX B</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M196"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">GRANDFATHERED AMOUNTS</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M197"></a>Distribution of amounts that were earned and vested (within the meaning of Code section 409A and regulations thereunder) under the Plan prior to 2005 (and earnings thereon) and are exempt from the requirements of Code section 409A shall be made in accordance with the Plan terms as in effect on December 31, 2004 and as summarized in this Appendix B.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M198"></a>B.1<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Timing</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;As soon as practicable following the final day of the Deferral Period for a specific deferral, the Company will distribute to the Participant (or in the case of the Participant&#8217;s death, his estate), all proceeds in the Participant&#8217;s Deferred Bonus Account and will issue to the Participant (or in the event of the Participant&#8217;s death, the personal representative or beneficiaries of his estate) shares of Stock credited to the Participant&#8217;s Deferred Stock Option Gain Account, that are attributed to that deferral.&nbsp;&nbsp;With respect to a specific deferral, the final day of the Deferral Period shall be the earliest of the last day of the Deferral Period selected by the Participant or the date he has a Termination of Employment.&nbsp;&nbsp;Upon Termination of Employment, a Participant will have the same rights with respect to an unexercised Option that he would have if he had not elected to defer the Stock Option Gain relating to that Option.&nbsp;&nbsp;The portion of a Participant&#8217;s Accounts that can be attributed to a specific deferral shall be determined in the sole discretion of the Plan Administrator.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M199"></a>B.2<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Extension of Deferral Period</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;On a one-time basis with respect to each deferral, a Participant may elect in accordance with procedures established by the Plan Administrator to extend the Deferral Period for a Bonus or Stock Option Gain for an additional five (5), seven (7), or ten (10) years, provided that such extension is elected in the calendar year prior, and at least six (6) months prior, to the expiration of the initial Deferral Period and the Participant is an Eligible Executive at the time he makes the election to extend the Deferral Period.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M200"></a>B.3<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Disability</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event of a Participant&#8217;s Disability and upon application by such Participant, the Plan Administrator may determine that payment of all, or part, of such Participant&#8217;s Accounts shall be made in a different manner, or on an earlier date than the time or times specified in Section B.1 above, but only to the extent determined by the Plan Administrator to be reasonably required to satisfy the Participant&#8217;s need.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M201"></a>B.4<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Investment of Accounts</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Notwithstanding Section 5.4, a Participant shall not have the right to select among Investment Options for amounts credited to the Participant&#8217;s Deferred Stock Option Gain Account.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such amounts shall be treated as if invested in Stock at all times.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M202"></a>B.5<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Definitions</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;For purposes of this Appendix B, the following terms shall have the meanings indicated below:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M203"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Bonus</font> means the amount payable by the Company to an Eligible Employee as an individual performance bonus, executive bonus or any other bonus/incentive award that is approved by the Plan Administrator for deferral under the Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M204"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Deferral Period</font> means with respect to a specific deferral of a Bonus or Stock Option Gain, the period of five (5), seven (7), or ten (10) years from the date on which the corresponding Bonus would otherwise have been paid or the date the Option was scheduled to expire had it not been exercised; provided that, in the event of the Participant&#8217;s Termination of Employment, the Deferral Period shall end on the date of Termination of Employment.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M205"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Deferred Bonus Account</font> means a bookkeeping account established for Bonuses deferred under the Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M206"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Deferred Stock Option Gain Account</font> means a bookkeeping account established for Stock Option Gains deferred under the Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M207"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Disability</font> means any long-term disability as defined under the Company&#8217;s long-term disability plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator, in its complete and sole discretion, shall determine a Participant&#8217;s Disability.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan Administrator may require that the Participant submit to an examination on an annual basis, at the expense of the Company, by a competent physician or medical clinic selected by the Plan Administrator to assist in the determination of Disability.&nbsp;&nbsp;On the basis of such medical evidence, the determination of the Plan Administrator as to whether or not a condition of Disability exists or continues shall be conclusive.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M208"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU13"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Eligible Executive</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> means a full-time employee of the Company who is (i) an elected officer of the Company, (ii) at the level of Vice President or above, (iii) at Level 16 or above on the Company&#8217;s salary range, and (iv) working within the United States of America.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, the Plan Administrator may, in his or her discretion, extend coverage to persons who are selected by the Plan Administrator and who either (y) meet all of the foregoing requirements except that they are working outside of the United States of America, or (z) are officers of a subsidiary of the Company.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M209"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Mature Shares</font> means shares of the Company&#8217;s Stock delivered by a Participant in payment of the exercise price of an Option; provided that Mature Shares shall not include any shares of the Company&#8217;s Stock that may be received upon exercise of such Option, nor Stock that the Participant purchased pursuant to a prior stock option exercise which occurred less than six months prior to the exercise of such Option.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M210"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Option</font> shall mean one or more non-qualified stock options, issued to a Participant under any stock option plan of the Company, with respect to which the Participant has elected to defer the Stock Option Gain.&nbsp;&nbsp;Option shall not include any rights under the Company&#8217;s Employee Stock Purchase Plan.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M211"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Stock</font> - means Microsoft Corporation common stock.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M212"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Stock Option Gain</font> means the number of shares underlying an Option minus the number of Mature Shares required to pay the exercise price for those shares.&nbsp;&nbsp;For example, if a Participant elects to defer the gain on 100 shares and is required to deliver 10 shares of Stock as payment for the exercise price on the 100 shares, the Stock Option Gain will be 90 shares.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M213"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Termination of Employment</font> means the termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment relationship with the Company for any reason including, without limitation, involuntary termination with or without cause, voluntary termination, disability, death, or retirement.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:13.89%;font-size:9pt;"><a name="_DV_M214"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M215"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;"><br /></font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU14"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">APPENDIX C</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M216"></a><font style="text-decoration:underline;">2005 DEFERRED COMPENSATION</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.94%;"><a name="_DV_M217"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M218"></a>This Appendix C sets forth the special rules applicable to compensation eligible for deferral under the Plan from January 1, 2005 through December 31, 2005.&nbsp;&nbsp;Unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings given to them in the Plan and Appendix B.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M219"></a>C-1.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">2005 Initial Deferral Elections</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Notwithstanding anything in Section 5.1 of the Plan to the contrary and only with respect to compensation earned during the 2005 Plan Year (&#8220;2005 Income&#8221;), a<font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">n Eligible Employee may make an irrevocable election to defer up to 100% of a Bonus in ten (10) percent increments.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font>Eligible Employees are not permitted to defer gains on the exercise of a stock option under the Plan after December 31, 2004.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M220"></a><a name="_DV_C60"></a><a name="_DV_M221"></a>C-2.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Time of Distribution</font><a name="_DV_C60"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company will distribute to the Participant (or in the case of the Participant&#8217;s death, his estate) all proceeds in the Participant&#8217;s Deferred Bonus Account that are attributed to a specific deferral upon the earlier of:&nbsp;&nbsp;(1) the last day of the Deferral Period elected by the Participant; or (2) the date of the Participant's Separation from Service; provided that, if a distribution is to be made upon the Separation from Service of a Key Employee, such distribution is subject to the six month delay set forth in Section <font style="color:#auto;border-bottom:double 2.5pt;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_M221"></a>6.4</font> of the Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M222"></a>For purposes of this Appendix C, &#8220;Deferral Period&#8221; means with respect to a specific deferral of a Bonus, the period, as elected by the Participant at the time of the deferral election, of five (5), seven (7), or ten (10) years from the date on which the corresponding Bonus would otherwise have been paid.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M223"></a>C-3.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;letter-spacing:0.1pt;">Changes in Time or Form of Distribution</font><font style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;To the extent the Company allows a Participant to make a subsequent election to change the time or form of distribution of 2005 Income deferred under the Plan, such election will be effective only if the conditions set forth in Section 6.7 of the Plan are satisfied.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M224"></a>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:6.94%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_M225"></a>C-4.<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;">General Application of the Plan</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;Other than as set forth above, the terms of the Plan in all other respects and in compliance with Code section 409A shall govern the distribution of 2005 Income deferred under the Plan from January 1, 2005 through December 31, 2005.
